_comment: src key -> the real file on disk. Keys are the only thing specs may reference; /api/src resolves through the generated allowlist, never through a path from the client.

wan.model.label: wan/modules/model.py
wan.model.note: WanModel is config-driven; the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B config loads into it unchanged.

wan.pipeline.label: diffsynth/pipelines/wan_video.py
wan.pipeline.note: The only local code path that actually runs the 1.3B checkpoint.

mmx.sglang.label: sglang multimodal_gen dits/minimax_h3.py
mmx.sglang.note: The serving implementation (what fl2va/UFAL actually runs).

wan.t2v.label: wan/text2video.py
wan.t2v.note: The canonical Wan sampling loop. The low/high-noise expert switch is Wan2.2-A14B only; 1.3B runs a single DiT.

mmx.pipe.label: videox_fun/pipeline/pipeline_minimax_h3.py
mmx.pipe.note: Builds the packed sequence: row order, token_tags, position_ids, per-modality indices.

qwen35.hf.label: transformers/models/qwen3_5/modeling_qwen3_5.py
qwen35.hf.note: Only in the lingbot-vomni env (tf 5.14.1); the serving `vllm` env's transformers predates qwen3_5.

qwen35.gdn.label: vllm .../mamba/gdn_linear_attn.py
qwen35.gdn.note: vLLM's GatedDeltaNet — the serving form of the linear-attention layer.
